Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Bradbury Chesterfield Classic Sofa, 92.9"W, Slate
Colors: Slate
Materials: Polyester
This lovely sofa has the low button-tufted back, scroll arms, and short legs that are the hallmark of the classic chesterfield style. Whether as a statement piece or part of a living-room suite, this sofa will be a welcome addition to any decor. Dimensions: 93"W x 39"D x 30"H Solid hardwood frame; upholstery: 98% polyester, 2% nylon Removable and reversible seat cushions A classic style updated in stain-resistant fabric makes this perfect for the modern home. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
